name: chrome-devtools
description: Codex Chrome DevTools plugin with route sessions, upstream MCP delegation, live evidence bundles, API discovery, redacted cURL, performance workflows, and sync guardrails.

interface.shortDescription: Debug Chrome pages with safe route sessions, DevTools evidence, API discovery, and performance checks.
interface.longDescription: @ChromeDevTools provides gated Chrome DevTools debugging workflows for Codex: isolated-by-default route sessions, upstream Chrome DevTools MCP delegation, live evidence bundles, API call inventory, redacted cURL generation, Lighthouse and performance summaries, and bounded heap analysis. Profile-connected modes require route-token ownership and URL policy. Heap aliases accept only relative snapshot paths, use bounded pagination, and redact/hash duplicate string values; raw memory debugging is never enabled globally. Live evidence is redaction-first, usage statistics and CrUX are disabled by default, and delegated tools run only after route-token, connection-source, and redaction gates pass.
defaultPrompt: Use @ChromeDevTools to inspect page API calls from fixture or gated live evidence.
Run the @ChromeDevTools upstream MCP doctor for an isolated route.
Use @ChromeDevTools to build a redaction-first live evidence, Lighthouse, performance, or bounded browser-memory bundle.
